description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - queue roam: on a ticket queue, the main line is roaming and the side line is not missing your number - register your ticket number, far-field listening passes call announcements through a ticket-number gate (only your own number banners hard, everything else is counted and discarded), report the screen progress manually when passing the call screen (no screen reading, no OCR), and a near threshold (5 numbers) calls you back before your turn, then a summary. No speaker identification, no official queue system: the gap is only arithmetic between your registered number and the manually reported progress. Session memory only, wiped on close.
name: queue-roam
